title: Without work order and part sale View: page opens, record-based list
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  2. A teammate at the same location to tag, User B (e.g. "Dana Lee"); they are listed under Settings -> Staff.
  3. Create the test role: Settings -> Roles & Permissions -> Create custom role -> choose a template (e.g. "Service Advisor") -> Apply; untick Work Orders -> View and Part Sales -> View, and leave Customers -> View ticked; enter the Role name "ZZAUTOTEST Customers only" and click Create. Assign it: Settings -> Staff -> open User B -> Edit Staff Member -> Role -> pick "ZZAUTOTEST Customers only" -> save. User B must log out and back in before testing (a role change ends their session).
  4. A work order at this location: Work Orders -> New Work Order, select a customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair"), save.
  5. A part sale at this location: Parts -> Part Sales -> New Part Sale, select the customer.
  6. The customer's own notes: Customers -> open the customer (e.g. "4 Star Truck Repair") -> Notes tab.
  7. An asset of that customer with a unit number, year, make and model (e.g. Unit 546, 2019 Freightliner Cascadia): Customers -> open the customer -> Assets tab -> open the asset (add one if none exists) -> Notes tab.
  8. To write a note on any of these records: on its Notes tab click New Note, type the message, type @ and pick the person, then save.
  9. As User A, write one note on each of the four records (work order, part sale, customer, asset), each @-mentioning User B.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as User B and click the bell in the top navigation.
  2. Read which notifications the Inbox lists, and the bell's count.
  3. Confirm nothing redirects you away from the Notifications page.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • User B can open the Notifications page; nothing redirects them and the bell behaves as it does today.
  • The Inbox lists no work order, work order line or part sale notification.
  • The customer note and the asset note notifications are listed (User B holds Customers -> View and can open the asset).

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10248 (S5, Reach tag groups, quick notes and preferences); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297) as edited 2 October 2026, S5; read 5 Oct 2026. Source-verified 5 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-N1: “A user without 'Work Orders → View' and without 'Part Sales → View' can still open the Notifications page.”
  • S5-N1: “They see no work order, work order line or part sale notifications.”
  • S5-N1: “They still see notifications from customer notes when they hold 'Customers → View', and from asset notes when they can open the asset (S1-R21).”
  • S5-N1: “Nothing redirects them, and the bell behaves for them exactly as it does today.”
